references.text: The context of eating one's own children during a siege is introduced here, and verse 57 continues this terrible description of desperation under God's judgment.
Describes the same situation of siege and distress where parents eat their children, parallel to verse 57's description of secret consumption.
An earlier warning in Leviticus that Israel will eat their own sons and daughters as punishment for disobedience.
The fulfillment of this curse during the siege of Samaria, where women ate their own children due to famine.
Lamentations describes the fulfillment of this curse during the fall of Jerusalem, where women ate their own children.
Another reference in Lamentations that compassionate women boiled their own children during the siege of Jerusalem.
Ezekiel prophesies that fathers will eat their sons and sons their fathers as judgment on Jerusalem, in line with the curse in Deuteronomy.
